name: Burp Bridge
description: Reload a target tab, collect browser-side visibility, and export a Burp-ingestible JSON report.

commands.title: Collect With Reload
commands.description: Reload the target tab, capture a browser-side report, and export versioned JSON.

commands.title: Collect Passive Snapshot
commands.description: Capture a browser-side snapshot without reloading the page.

commands.title: Collect Full Instrumented Snapshot
commands.description: Reload the target and force document-start instrumentation for a comprehensive browser-side report.

settingsSchema.title: Default Mode
settingsSchema.description: Choose the collection depth used by operator-triggered runs.

settingsSchema.title: Reload Before Collect
settingsSchema.description: Refresh the page before gathering the browser-side report.

settingsSchema.title: Auto-Capture On Navigation
settingsSchema.description: Automatically run a passive collection (no reload) and send it to Burp whenever a top-level page finishes loading, without needing to click Collect.

settingsSchema.title: Auto-Send To Burp
settingsSchema.description: POST each completed export to the configured Burp ingestion endpoint after collection.

settingsSchema.title: Burp Ingest URL
settingsSchema.description: Proxy-visible endpoint consumed by the Burp extension for automatic export ingestion.

settingsSchema.title: Resource Entry Cap
settingsSchema.description: Maximum performance resource entries to keep per frame.

settingsSchema.title: Cache Entry Cap
settingsSchema.description: Maximum Cache Storage request URLs to keep per cache.

settingsSchema.title: Storage Value Cap
settingsSchema.description: Maximum serialized characters kept for storage values.

collectors.name: Page Snapshot Collector
collectors.description: Collects page, resource, storage, and runtime metadata from each frame.

collectors.name: Instrumentation Bridge Collector
collectors.description: Reads document_start instrumentation events for dynamic artifacts and blob URLs.

collectors.name: Frame Structure Collector
collectors.description: Enumerates the known frame tree and frame URLs from Chromium.

uiContributions.title: Burp Bridge Console
uiContributions.description: Run export collections from the side panel.

uiContributions.title: Burp Bridge Console
uiContributions.description: Run export collections against the inspected tab.
